parameters.name: StorageRef
parameters.description: Specifies the memory path where the messages are stored.

parameters.name: CapacityLimit
parameters.description: Maximum number of outgoing SMS messages to be stored. If the number of outgoing messages in {{object|Device.Cellular.Interface.{i}.SMS.Message}} exceeds CapacityLimit, the oldest outgoing messages will be removed automatically to prevent storage overfilling. -1 disables automatic messages removal.

object.description: This object models outgoing SMS configuration.
